cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. If you won the combat, recover 1 health.
cards.title: TROPHY

cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card. If you're attacking a sidekick, also ignore its value.
cards.title: FEROCITY

cards.afterText: Place Jason on any empty space in his zone.
cards.title: HUNT

cards.duringText: If both fighters are in the same zone together with no other fighters in their zone, this card's value is 5 instead.
cards.title: CORNERED

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, move each of the fighters in the combat up to 2 spaces (in any order).
cards.title: TERRORIZE

cards.duringText: Your opponent discards 1 random card. Add its BOOST value to this card's attack value.
cards.title: AMBUSH

cards.afterText: The opposing fighter takes damage equal to the damage they took this combat. Then if they have 2 or less health, defeat them.
cards.title: BRUTALITY

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to each fighter adjacent to Jason.
cards.title: SAVAGERY

cards.afterText: The opposing fighter has 0 Move until your next turn (they may still BOOST to increase their Move).
cards.title: KILLER

cards.duringText: If Jason would be defeated, instead prevent all damage and remove Jason from the board. At the start your next turn, place Jason in any space.
cards.title: JASON LIVES

cards.afterText: Move Jason up to 4 spaces. Then if Jason is adjacent to an opposing fighter, he recovers 2 health.
cards.title: UNSTOPPABLE

cards.basicText: If you lost a combat this turn, gain 2 actions. Otherwise move Jason up to 2 spaces and gain 1 action.
cards.title: FURIOUS ZEAL

cards.basicText: Draw 2 cards. If Jason is the only fighter in his zone, Jason recovers 2 health.
cards.title: GRIM OMEN

hero.name: Jason Voorhees
hero.specialAbility: When Jason maneuvers, if there are no opposing fighters in Jason's zone, you may start Jason's maneuver in any space in his zone.

sidekick.quote: "Jason's out there... Watching... Always on the prowl for intruders... Ready to kill... Ready to devour... Thirsty for young blood."

name: Jason Voorhees
